levels.label: א
levels.name: Alef
levels.guidance: Write for an end-of-Alef learner who can decode unpointed Hebrew. Use short sentences, frequent vocabulary, a clear event sequence, and very few subordinate clauses. Keep the voice adult and natural.

levels.label: א+
levels.name: Alef Plus
levels.guidance: Write for advanced Alef. Use past tense, simple cause and effect, natural connectors, common fixed expressions, and limited subordinate clauses while keeping the story easy to follow.

levels.label: ב
levels.name: Bet
levels.guidance: Write reasonably natural contemporary Hebrew with useful detail, causes, comparisons, reactions, and common colloquial constructions. Avoid dense journalistic syntax and specialist vocabulary.
